Normal_Bone.description: Normal healthy bone structure with no abnormalities detected.

Fracture.description: A break or crack in a bone caused by trauma, stress, or disease.
Fracture.treatment: Immobilization (cast/splint), surgery for complex fractures, physiotherapy

Osteoporosis.description: Reduced bone density making bones weak and more prone to fractures.
Osteoporosis.treatment: Calcium+Vitamin D, bisphosphonates (alendronate), lifestyle changes, weight-bearing exercise

Osteoarthritis.description: Degenerative joint disease causing cartilage breakdown and bone changes.
Osteoarthritis.treatment: Pain management (NSAIDs), physiotherapy, weight loss, joint replacement if severe
